<thought>Analyzing the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 147.00, 133.90, 128.91 (two peaks), and 127.68 (two peaks), totaling six distinct aromatic carbon signals. This corresponds to six aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
